response.sql: WITH matched_records AS (SELECT sc.cureregistry, s.healtheval FROM scanconservation sc INNER JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry), status_counts AS (SELECT healtheval, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM matched_records GROUP BY healtheval), total_count AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) as total FROM status_counts), with_shares AS (SELECT healtheval, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT total FROM total_count) as share FROM status_counts), global_stats AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM with_shares), above_average AS (SELECT cnt, share, share - (SELECT avg_share FROM global_stats) as excess FROM with_shares WHERE share > (SELECT avg_share FROM global_stats)) SELECT AVG(CAST(cnt AS REAL)) as avg_count, AVG(share) as avg_share, AVG(excess) as avg_excess FROM above_average
